cards.text: Jeremiah the prophet is passing along a message from the LORD about prophets who claim to speak for Him. And the LORD opens with a question. “Am I only a God nearby,” declares the LORD, “and not a God far away?”

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says a man can hide in secret places where He cannot see him.

cards.text: Nope, the LORD fills the heavens and the earth. Friend, I spent YEARS in the back of a junk drawer sure nobody could see me, and the Most High knew exactly which drawer.
Then the LORD says He has heard what the prophets are saying, the ones who prophesy lies in His name.

cards.question: The prophets who prophesy lies in the LORD's name keep announcing they had something. What is it?

cards.text: Their big line is “I had a dream! I had a dream!” TWICE, friend, like the buddy who texts you his whole dream at six in the morning before you've even found your glasses.

cards.question: The LORD asks how long this will go on with these prophets. Where does He say their dreams really come from?

cards.text: These prophets tell their dreams to one another. And the LORD says what they suppose all those dreams will do to His people.

cards.question: What do the prophets suppose their dreams will make the LORD's people do?
The LORD says the people's fathers forgot His name the same way, through the worship of ___.

cards.text: Then the LORD draws a line: let the one with a dream retell it, but let the one with His word speak it truthfully. And He asks what straw is compared to grain.

cards.question: True or false: In the LORD's picture of straw and grain, His word is the straw.

cards.text: His word is the grain, friend, and those dreams are me holding up a cookie next to a PICTURE of a cookie. Only one of those is going in the box.
“Is not My word like fire,” declares the LORD, “and like a hammer that smashes a rock?” And these guys show up with a dream, friend, which is bringing a PILLOW to a hammer fight.

cards.question: The LORD says His word is like fire and like a hammer that smashes a rock. What do those pictures show about His word?

cards.text: Then the LORD says He is against the prophets, and He spells out exactly which ones. First up, the prophets with words they attribute to Him.

cards.question: Where do these prophets get the words they say came from the LORD?

answers.text: They steal them from one another
They copy them from old scrolls
They buy them from the priests

cards.text: Next, the prophets who wag their own tongues and proclaim, “The LORD declares it.” That's the coworker who starts every rumor with “the boss said,” and the boss said NOTHING.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says He sent the prophets with false dreams, but they changed His message along the way.
The LORD says these prophets lead His people astray with reckless lies. How much do they benefit His people?

cards.text: Now the LORD takes on a phrase people keep using: “the burden of the LORD.” He says that when this people or a prophet or priest asks, “What is the burden of the LORD?” there's an answer they're to be given.

cards.question: When someone asks what the burden of the LORD is, the answer starts with “What burden?” What does the LORD then say He will do?

cards.text: Then there's the prophet or priest or anyone who claims, “This is the burden of the LORD.” The LORD has something to say about that man.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says He will punish the man who claims “This is the burden of the LORD,” and his household too.
Instead of claiming “This is the burden of the LORD,” what does the LORD say each man should ask his friend and his brother?

cards.text: Then the LORD tells them to refer no more to the burden of the LORD. And He gives the reason.

cards.question: Why does the LORD tell the people to refer no more to the burden of the LORD?

answers.text: They twist the words of the living God
They say the phrase far too often
Only the priests may say the phrase

cards.text: The LORD says “each man’s word becomes the burden.” Picture every baker in here writing their own recipe on a card and signing it “Papa Dorin,” and give it a WEEK, friend, nobody knows what Papa Dorin actually said.

cards.question: Same idea when the people go to a prophet. True or false: The LORD tells them to ask the prophet, “What has the LORD spoken?”

cards.text: But if anyone claims “This is the burden of the LORD” anyway, the LORD says He specifically told them not to make this claim. Friend, “specifically told you not to” is the voice in my head every time the timer says not yet and I open the oven ANYWAY.

cards.question: Because they made the claim He told them not to make, what does the LORD say He will surely do?

answers.text: Forget them and cast them out

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says the city He gave to them and their fathers would be cast out of His presence along with them.
The LORD says He will bring everlasting shame and perpetual humiliation that will never be ___.

cards.text: Notice that word, friend: forget. The prophets supposed their dreams would make God's people forget His name, and now the LORD says He will surely forget them, with a shame that will never be forgotten.
